About

Registered Nurse and Midwife with experience in clinical care, telehealth, healthcare administration, and nursing research. Skilled in patient communication, electronic medical record (EMR) documentation, healthcare coordination, and administrative support, with a strong commitment to delivering high quality, patient centered services. Experienced in supporting research activities, literature reviews, and evidence based practice, with a growing interest in digital health and healthcare innovation. A detail oriented, adaptable, and proactive professional who values integrity, continuous learning, and collaboration, and is passionate about helping healthcare organizations improve patient outcomes through efficient administrative support, technology, and research.

Conferences and Academic Engagement

April 21 to 23, 2026

CNMF West Africa Regional Conference

Abuja, Nigeria, Commonwealth Nursing and Midwifery Federation

Presented my abstract, "Beyond the Classroom: Enhancing Nursing Education Through Professional Experiences and Volunteer Opportunities." My cross sectional study of 150 graduate nurses found that volunteering and professional exposure during training sharpened career clarity, strengthened CVs, and built adaptability and teamwork beyond the clinical floor. I also moderated a session, guiding discussion among nursing leaders, researchers, and educators.
